_readme: En-route Center sectors. name = station as spoken, fir = ICAO FIR/ACC code, frequency = MHz string
or exactly "PLACEHOLDER". ATC never hands off to a PLACEHOLDER sector: fill in the real frequency first.
lower_ft/upper_ft = MSL band (lower inclusive, upper exclusive). polygon = [lat, lon] points.
Where sectors overlap at the same altitude, the first one in this list wins.
The polygons below are ROUGH boxes for testing EDDH-EDDM, not the real sector boundaries.
